context: The Liquidity Pool Advanced Market Chart rendered but returned no XRBC/XRP historical candles. Investigation showed the original Sologenic OHLC path had documented issuer-coverage limitations that did not include the exact XRBC issuer, and the chart requested only a short recent window.

root_cause.issue: Published Mainnet issuer-coverage limitations do not include the exact XRBC issuer, so a syntactically valid XRBC/XRP request could return no historical candles.
root_cause.old_window: Approximately 360 intervals at the selected timeframe.

replacement.identity: Exact currency + issuer for issued assets; XRP for native XRP.
replacement.pagination: Uses provider marker to request older history backward.

1d.paging: up to 2 pages backward; broadest default market-history view

evidence_boundary.historical_candles: Processed XRPL DEX trade history for charting/indicators/export only.
evidence_boundary.current_market_snapshot: Existing XRBitcoinCash read-only Render/XRPL path using validated ledger + exact book_offers + amm_info.
evidence_boundary.transactions: Transaction preview, construction, signing and validated finality do not use the historical provider.

safety_invariants: No ticker-only or similarly named token substitution.
Provider response pair identity is checked before accepting history.
Exact 40-character currency hex may be matched to the decoded representation of that same hex identity, with issuer equality still required.
Historical candles and current book/AMM liquidity remain separate evidence sources.
No wallet, AMM transaction, trustline, signing, gate, receipt or finality logic was intentionally changed.
manual_follow_up: Reload the deployed Liquidity Pool in a normal browser.
Leave 1D · MAX selected and confirm exact XRBC/XRP historical candles appear.
Read the returned-history range to confirm the earliest provider trade date.

If direct provider access is blocked by browser/CORS/network policy, preserve exact-pair history semantics and route the same request through a reviewed read-only backend endpoint rather than reverting to token substitution.
